question: How far in advance should we book?
answer: We recommend booking 6-12 months in advance for peak wedding season (May-October). Popular Saturday dates in summer can book up to a year out. That said, we always try to accommodate last-minute requests — check your date and we'll let you know.

question: How long does setup and teardown take?
answer: Typical setup takes 60-90 minutes depending on the package size. We arrive well before your guests and are fully set up before cocktail hour begins. Teardown takes about 30 minutes — we strike quietly at the end of the night while your last guests are heading out.

question: What if it rains on our outdoor wedding?
answer: All our outdoor equipment is IP65 weather-rated, meaning it's fully protected against rain. We also carry backup indoor plans for every outdoor setup. We monitor the weather closely in the days leading up to your event and will proactively communicate any adjustments.

question: Do we need to provide power?
answer: Most of our LED fixtures are wireless and battery-powered — no extension cords or power drops needed. For larger productions with moving heads or haze machines, we'll coordinate power requirements with your venue in advance. We handle all the logistics.

question: Can you match our wedding colours?
answer: Absolutely. Our LED fixtures can produce any colour in the spectrum. During our planning consultation, we'll match your palette exactly and program custom colour scenes into the DMX controller. You'll approve the colours before the event.

question: Are cold sparks safe for indoor venues?
answer: Yes — cold sparks use titanium powder that produces sparks which are cool to the touch within seconds. There's no fire risk, no smoke, and no residue. Most venues that prohibit traditional pyrotechnics approve cold sparks. We carry all necessary safety certifications and insurance.

question: Do you provide a technician for the whole event?
answer: Every package includes an on-site technician for the duration of your event. They handle setup, run the lighting live throughout the evening (including real-time dimming for first dances, speeches, etc.), and manage teardown. You never have to think about the lights.

question: What's the difference between your packages?
answer: The Romantic Glow focuses on warm amber tones and string lights — perfect for rustic and intimate settings. The Modern Gala uses crisp whites and precision pinspots for an editorial feel. The Epic Afterparty adds moving lights, haze, and cold sparks for maximum wow factor. All packages include DMX control and an on-site technician.

question: Do you work with our DJ or planner?
answer: Always. We coordinate with your DJ on music cues (dimming for first dance, ramping up for party time) and with your planner on timeline and logistics. We're used to working as part of a vendor team and pride ourselves on being easy to collaborate with.

question: What areas do you serve?
answer: We're based in London, ON and serve the entire region including Kitchener-Waterloo, Guelph, Stratford, St. Thomas, and Woodstock. Travel within this area is included in all packages — no hidden fees.

question: How much does wedding lighting cost?
answer: Pricing depends on your venue size, the package you choose, and any add-ons like cold sparks or moving heads. Most wedding lighting packages fall in the mid-range for the region, and every quote is firm and all-inclusive — design, fixtures, the on-site technician, setup, and teardown are all covered with no surprise fees. Tell us your date and venue and we'll send exact pricing within 4 business hours.

question: Do you require a deposit to book?
answer: Yes. To reserve your date we ask for a 25% deposit, with the balance due before the event. Once your deposit is in, your date is locked and we begin planning the details — colour matching, scene programming, and coordinating with your other vendors.

question: What is your cancellation or rescheduling policy?
answer: We understand plans change. Deposits are transferable to a new date subject to availability, and we'll always do our best to accommodate a reschedule. Specific cancellation terms are spelled out clearly in your written proposal before you sign — no fine print, no surprises.

question: Can you light both the ceremony and reception?
answer: Absolutely. Many couples have us light the ceremony, cocktail hour, and reception as one seamless experience. If your ceremony and reception are in different spaces, we'll plan the transition so each area is lit perfectly when guests arrive — and your technician manages it all live.

question: How far in advance do we need to finalize our colours and design?
answer: We'll lock in your colours and lighting scenes during a planning consultation, typically a few weeks before your event. Because our fixtures can produce any colour in the spectrum, last-minute palette tweaks are easy — we simply reprogram the DMX controller. You'll approve everything before the day.

question: Do you do corporate events and Christmas parties, or just weddings?
answer: All three, plus backyard and private parties. Corporate galas, product launches, staff socials, office holiday parties and home Christmas parties make up roughly half of our calendar. Holiday decor (garlands, wreaths, decorated trees) and commercial or mall holiday displays are available from October through January.

question: What does uplighting cost?
answer: Uplighting starts at $395 for 10 wireless LED uplights delivered, placed and programmed. Most reception halls use 12 to 20. See the Packages page for bundled pricing with string lights, pinspots and a technician.

question: How much does Edison string lighting cost?
answer: Installed Edison and bistro string lighting starts at $895 for a 100 ft canopy and runs about $6 per foot beyond that. Tent ceiling grids and multi-day installs are quoted per job.

question: Can you supply and install garlands, wreaths and a decorated tree for our party?
answer: Yes. We deliver pre-lit garlands, oversized wreaths and fully decorated trees, style them on site and remove them after your party or in January. Rental and purchase options are both available.

question: Do you handle mall and large commercial holiday displays?
answer: Yes. Giant atrium trees, Santa photo sets, lit sculptures, walk-through light tunnels and exterior roofline lighting for malls, plazas, office towers and municipalities. These are designed and quoted per property, with overnight installs and a maintenance schedule.
